rows: Recurring donor screening and transfusion activity
About 11 million whole-blood units and 4 million apheresis platelet and plasma units a year in the U.S.; more than 1.6 million donations in Mexico (2024)
DAT, antibody investigation and transfusion-reaction workups are core hospital transfusion-lab procedures
U.S. leads regional adoption of automated immunohematology, gel and column systems and connected blood-bank software
Fragmented procurement in Canada and Mexico
Provincial operators and budgets in Canada; public tenders, social security and private contracts in Mexico
Switching platforms requires validation, documentation, training, LIS integration and antibody-history continuity
Broadest opportunity for automation, DAT, software connectivity and extended phenotype support
Centralized reference testing and complex antigen matching
Bundled reagent-and-equipment contracts; voluntary donations were 8.3% vs replacement 91.7% (2023)
Source: Grand View Research, Blood Bank Serology Market Analysis and Segment Forecast to 2033 (2026), Chapter 9.2 (North America)
